I peered at the kettle and the cup on the floor, taking note of their condition. As I descended the hatch, I found myself in a low, damp cistern, navigating by feel, the water hidden from sight.

runs.narrative: In the fictional world of this text adventure, I am an unnamed protagonist on a journey. I started in a cramped galley where salt was everywhere, with a doorway leading north and a hatch in the floor going down to the south. The only item I found there was a kettle. I picked it up. I then ventured north into a store that reeked of paraffin and found a coil of rope that was stiff with salt. I took it and continued my exploration. I climbed the staircase to the east and found myself on a landing with a window that does not open. There, I saw a brass key on the floor. I have not done anything with it yet. My inventory includes a kettle and a coil of rope. I do not know where this adventure will lead me next.

I am a curious explorer, venturing into an abandoned ship with only a kettle, a coil of rope, and an oil can as my tools. I discovered a series of rooms, each with its own set of challenges and mysteries. In the galley, I found a kettle filled with saltwater, and in the store, I took a coil of rope that was stiff with salt. In the lamp room, I found a logbook, which I read and wrote in, recording my journey. I also discovered a half-full oil can. As I ventured further down, I encountered a half-turn of stairs with a window that did not open and a brass key on the floor. I returned to the lamp room, where I dropped the oil can and continued to explore. Throughout my journey, I had to be resourceful and creative, using my tools to navigate and solve the puzzles I encountered. My adventure ended in the lamp room, where I am now writing about my experiences.
